Nivel de vechime: Asociat

Sectoare de activitate: Industria prelucrătoare
Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 Your Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive security assessments for new and existing IT applications and services like SaaS, Web-Applications, or infrastructure services.
Identify and evaluate security vulnerabilities and risks using industry-standard methodologies and tools.
Provide recommendations for security controls and improvements based on assessment findings.
Stay up-to-date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and regulatory requirements.
Assist in the development and maintenance of security policies, procedures, and guidelines.
Engage with vendors and third-party service providers to ensure their compliance with security standards.
 Your Qualifications
Several years of professional experience as a Security Specialist, preferably with a focus on technical audits, application security assessments and building or reviewing threat models.
Strong knowledge of security methodologies, frameworks, and best practices (e.g., OWASP, NIST).
An understanding of web service frameworks, security application architectures, and service architectures (such as event-driven, service-oriented, or serverless architectures).
An understanding of networking and communication protocols (such as TCP/IP, UDP, SSL/TLS, IPSEC, HTTP, HTTPS, BGP).
For this position you need a deep technical foundation in Cloud in the areas of native security tooling and API.
English language – Advanced/ Expert level.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and thorough referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
